fx_residual_regressions.note: weekly USD return of the line regressed on its US analogue and on the FX rate of its quote currency. If a 2x product applied its leverage to the EUR-translated index, the USD-converted line would load -(L-1) = -1.0 on EURUSD; ~0 means the quote currency is only a wrapper. Same-date Yahoo FX is ~16.5h stale at a European close, which by itself creates a positive loading; USD-line placebos show what the European close time alone produces.
